20 Best Prom Suits for Women That Are Chic and Versatile

Including pantsuits, jumpsuits, and skirt sets!
By Shauna Beni-Haynes
March 15, 2024

      All products are independently selected by our editors. If you buy something, we may earn an affiliate commission.

      Who says you need to wear a dress for prom? The best prom suits for women are a great alternative to dresses and can help you stand out in a crowd full of gowns on the big night.

      Aside from being a unique choice (which adds to the cool factor), prom suits are also comfy to wear. You won’t have to worry about sitting in a specific position (like you would in short prom dresses), and there will be no issue with folks stepping on your long gown all night while you get busy on the dance floor.

      The best part about prom suits? They look great when paired with stylish prom sneakers. Plus, when the night is over, you can reuse your ensemble for other fancy occasions – dress it up or down when required and mix and match the blazer or pants with other pieces in your wardrobe.

      So, if you’ve been scrolling through prom dress websites, check out our roundup featuring the best prom suits for teen girls (or guys, or anyone!) to help narrow down your search. We pulled TikTok viral looks and inspiration from NYFW to find the cutest styles for you. From sequin embellished pantsuits to plus-size satin cropped jumpsuits and the classic tailored tuxedo suit, there’s sure to be a style that’ll catch your eye.

      Best Prom Suits for Women:

      • Best prom suit overall: Youcai Formal Suit, $59
      • Best prom suit with a corset: Shona Joy Irena Button Up Bodice + Irena Mid Rise Pant, $480
      • Best designer prom pantsuit: Le Superbe Bianca Studded Blazer + Le Superbe Bianca Studded Pants, $970
      • Best affordable prom suit: Libodu Pantsuit, $70
      • Best unique prom suit: ASOS LUXE Bandeau Vest + ASOS Luxe tailored skinny flared pants in gray, $92
